verdict.rationale: Missive ships AI assistant features, so a training opt-out or no-training policy is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack contains no documented policy, setting, or commitment that prevents customer data from being used to train AI models. The note that the assistant runs on your own Anthropic/OpenAI/Gemini API key is an adjacent bring-your-own-key arrangement, not a documented training protection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
